'''Dioll''' was a rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Dioll system/Legends|Dioll system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Kassido Bypass]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Kardura system/Legends|Kardura]] and [[Thermon system/Legends|Thermon systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Dioll's climate contradictorily featured both strong [[Atmosphere/Legends|winds]] and deep fogs, and in that way it resembled a miniature version of a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type planet. Dioll was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Diollan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and, like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, was under the control of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dioll was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
